label: Best in Class
corporate_parent: TOTO Ltd — public (Tokyo Stock Exchange), Japan, founded 1917.
manufacturing_location: Morrow, Georgia, USA (primary US production) and Lakewood, Georgia. Some models from Kitakyushu, Japan.
outlook_rationale: TOTO Ltd is global leader. US manufacturing in Georgia provides domestic supply chain advantage. Strong plumbing supply house distribution (Ferguson, SupplyHouse).
platform_disclosure: TOTO Ultramax II shares the TORNADO FLUSH engine with the Neorest, Drake II, Aquia IV, and other current-gen TOTO models. The Ultramax II is the one-piece version of the Drake II platform (which is two-piece). Same flush mechanism, same CeFiONtect glaze, same trapway design. Ultramax II = Drake II + one-piece construction + skirted bowl + SoftClose seat included.

construction.description: One-piece vitreous china, skirted concealed trapway. No tank-to-bowl gasket joint. More difficult to ship/install (heavier, 90+ lbs) but eliminates hardware corrosion failure point.

glazing.description: CeFiONtect nano-glaze — same zirconium oxide barrier as Neorest. Prevents waste adhesion. Documented long-term bowl cleanliness advantage over all competing glazes.

trapway.description: Fully glazed 2-1/8" trapway. Smooth internal surface. Larger than Kohler/American Standard 2" standard.

china_body.description: High-fire vitreous china. TOTO fires at >1200°C — denser, more chip-resistant. Georgia USA factory maintains TOTO quality standards.

seat.description: SoftClose seat included. Slow-close hinge mechanism prevents slamming. Standard TOTO quality.

map_score.notes: TORNADO FLUSH system. Documented MaP 1000g (MaP PREMIUM). Top performance tier. Consistent across TOTO TORNADO FLUSH models.

performance_evidence.flush_technology: TORNADO FLUSH — two powerful jets create centrifugal rinse washing entire bowl surface. Rimless design = no rim holes to clog. More efficient rinse than standard rim-fed wash.
performance_evidence.bowl_cleanliness: Excellent — TORNADO FLUSH centrifugal rinse + CeFiONtect = best combination for long-term bowl cleanliness. Plumber consensus.
performance_evidence.noise: Standard gravity flush noise. Quieter than pressure-assisted.

flush_valve.description: 3-inch silicone flapper — 7-10 year expected life (vs 3-5 yr rubber). Standard replacement available through TOTO parts or compatible aftermarket.

fill_valve.description: TOTO proprietary fill valve. Fluidmaster 400A may be compatible for replacement (confirm fitment). OEM TOTO valve available through supply houses.

parts_ecosystem.description: TOTO parts available through Ferguson, SupplyHouse.com, totousaparts.com. Flapper and basic internals are standard replacement items. Better parts ecosystem than Neorest (no smart components).

durability_evidence.diy_repairability: Mostly DIY — flapper replacement, fill valve replacement, supply line, wax ring all DIY-accessible. One-piece doesn't require tank removal for internal access. SoftClose seat is removable for cleaning.
durability_evidence.warranty: 1 year limited residential warranty. Limited lifetime on china body. Standard for TOTO.

sources.snippet: TOTO Ultramax II: MaP 1000g. MaP PREMIUM certified. TORNADO FLUSH system is the highest-performing gravity flush platform tested.
Plumber consensus: TOTO Ultramax II is the #1 recommended residential toilet. '44-year veteran: TOTO is the best period.' CeFiONtect longevity confirmed by installers.
TOTO models consistently top-rated. Ultramax II scores highly for flushing, bowl cleaning, and overall owner satisfaction.
TOTO valves rarely run. Lowest reported service call frequency among major brands. Silicone flapper lasts 7-10 years.
Strong plumber endorsement. 'If it were my house, I'd install a TOTO Ultramax II or Drake II.' TORNADO FLUSH = best bowl wash.
TOTO Ultramax II identified as 'benchmark for toilet performance' — powerful flushing plus water-saving. One-piece construction = premium quality.

bottom_line: The TOTO Ultramax II is the conventional toilet benchmark. TORNADO FLUSH + CeFiONtect at the workhorse price point. MaP 1000g flush performance. One-piece skirted construction. US manufacturing in Georgia. Plumber #1 recommendation for residential install. Better durability ecosystem than the Neorest (standard flapper + fill valve vs proprietary electronics). This is the toilet plumbers install in their own homes.
